fields.name: decisionManager
fields.label: Decision
fields.helpText: APPROUVER starts the creation in the HRIS, the IAM and the ITSM. CORRIGER sends the record back to HR. REFUSER closes the request without creating anything.

fields.name: commentaireManager
fields.label: Comment
fields.helpText: What needs correcting, or the reason for refusal.

fields.name: niveauAcces
fields.label: Access granted
fields.helpText: STANDARD leaves the account in the default groups; DEVELOPPEURS or DIRECTION adds it to that group in the IAM. This choice, not the profile on the record, decides the group.

fields.name: actionIncident
fields.label: Action
fields.helpText: REESSAYER replays the failed call ("Last technical incident" field of the record). ABANDONNER deletes what was already created in the IAM and the HRIS, then closes the request.
